title: Anyone else??
content: The stairs are usually darker for me, but otherwise I go here a lot, like a lot a lot. On the bottom of the steps is a gazebo? Or Monster House, depending 👀🤷🏼‍♀️ On the left is where the beach is and on the right is an area with a dock that is covered in cat tails and weeds, there might be a small stream under the dock but there isn't really water there.
